authority: F04A.4 plus N00.1/2; no new formula or native capture required.
mandatory_order: sqrt result -> R32 before gain multiply
finding: The two final sqrt F32 constants are unchanged if these particular literal inputs were first rounded to F32. Retaining the sqrt weight in binary64 through gain multiplication is a different expression and can change results. A claim that changing only literal-input precision invalidates output needs the exact expression/rounding point clarified.
signed_zero: N00 IEEE RNE add/multiply rules; cancellation +0, -0+-0=-0, multiplication XOR sign.
reference_algorithm: Decode finite IEEE words to exact Fraction. Round rational at every declared operation using quotient/remainder and ties-even. For sqrt64, binary-search adjacent positive IEEE words then compare input exactly with the squared midpoint. This avoids reliance on platform sqrt/libm in the independent reference.
scope: F04A prefix contribution primitive and synthetic previous/current half recomputation. F04G spread/gain generation, diffusion filter internals, whole g0-g2 matrix/ring/filter pipeline and native bit-exact conformance are outside this audit.
